messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Switch the camera setup to a rear-view dolly-in shot that moves from full-body to upper-body framing. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Retain the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action in the same environment. Only change how the camera captures the scene. Preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please switch the camera setup to a rear-view dolly-in shot that moves from full-body to upper-body framing. Retain the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action in the same environment. Only change how the camera captures the scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands in profile, then raises both arms to adjust her hair before turning her back to the camera.","camera":"The camera is at a low angle, initially framing the character in full profile and then moving closer to show her upper body and back as she turns.","clothing":"She wears a short, blue and white patterned romper with off-the-shoulder sleeves and pink flat shoes.","hair_color":"Bright blue.","hairstyle":"Hair is styled in two small buns on top of the head, with a braided band visible around the back of the head.","identity":"A 3D-rendered female character with a slim build and light skin.","scene":"The setting is a cobblestone street lined with red brick buildings, street lamps, and a street sign reading '11th St'."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output begins with a full-body profile view matching the reference, then the camera moves closer and the character turns so her back is shown in upper-body framing. The character, blue hair, blue-and-white romper, pink shoes, street environment, and hair-adjusting action remain broadly consistent.
arguments.requested_change: Switch to a rear-view dolly-in camera shot moving from full-body to upper-body framing, using the reference for initial direction, placement, and framing while preserving the same character, appearance, action, environment, and timing.
uncertain: Exact preservation of timing and action progression cannot be verified precisely from the sampled frames.
unexpected_changes: The initial framing is more profile than rear-view, though the reference itself shows a profile view and the shot later becomes rear-facing.
